checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same man, short grey hair, recognisable features
must.why: Hair, eyes, stubble, and expression match closely; face slightly sharper/older but recognisable.
Navy blazer and white open-collar shirt.

must.item: Harsh lighting softened, realistic skin texture kept
must.why: Even soft lighting with visible natural skin texture.
Clean composition; no obvious artifacts, though the face looks slightly reworked.

faults.what: Face is slightly re-rendered: sharper, more wrinkled and more defined than the original, so identity drifts a little. Shirt collar is somewhat wide and open.

summary: A polished headshot of the same man in a navy blazer and white shirt on a grey studio background, with only a slight face re-rendering as a drawback.
